description: This file defines the TextFrameRenderer class responsible for rendering text frames within the MigraDoc document rendering system. It includes methods for formatting, rendering, and transforming text frames with different orientations.

classes.name: TextFrameRenderer
classes.description: A class that renders text frames in the MigraDoc document rendering process, handling formatting, orientation, and drawing of text frames.

methods.name: TextFrameRenderer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the renderer with graphics context, text frame, and optional field information.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Formats the text frame for rendering, applying layout and style.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Performs the rendering of the text frame, including filling, content, and line drawing.

methods.name: RenderContent
methods.description: Renders the content of the text frame, including applying transformations based on orientation.

methods.name: Transform
methods.description: Applies transformations to the graphics context based on text orientation for proper rendering.

methods.name: ResetTransform
methods.description: Restores the graphics context to its previous state after transformations.
